blocker: The address-led frontier stage could discover public property/address clues, but its candidate extraction accepted only currently indexed savills.co.uk URLs. Historical Savills lot URLs surfaced inside web.archive.org search results or snippets were discarded before first-party revalidation, so the persisted next_safe_route (use address/postcode clues against free archives/indexes to recover old Savills slugs/PIDs) was not actually executable.

changes: extract original Savills URLs embedded in Wayback result URLs and snippets
search exact postcode plus compact street/locality fragments against legacy LotDetails and migrated /auctions/ paths
send recovered originals through the existing recover_candidate first-party validation gate before any History V2 persistence
record archive candidate counts and a distinct next route when no validated event is added

acceptance_rule: Archived/public-index evidence is discovery-only. Canonical History V2 persistence still requires a surviving Savills-owned page whose auction date and commercial/mixed-use classification validate.
